scope: Measure CJK/full-width text, sanitize ANSI/control sequences, wrap and truncate text by display columns.

integration_note: Production workbench wraps page headings, summaries, action lists and component catalog detail lines by terminal width. Real child-process help, parse errors, and human `runs list` output keep stdout/stderr separate and emit no ANSI under redirection.
